title: Defer the Meadow sharpening hitch as not important
context: Spec criterion 10.14 asks for no frame over 33 ms while the sharp scene bakes and fades in. On merged main, on a cool Note 10+, that phase lasts 1.2 to 1.4 s after the Meadow opens: 29 to 38 frames exceed 33 ms (mean 59 to 72 ms, longest 134 to 183 ms). Build takes about 8 ms and raster 23 to 29 ms; the rest is waiting behind sharp bakes queued on the raster thread, with the 300 ms opacity crossfade at the end. Scale 0.85 and 0.75 do not help. The owner's MacBook Pro showed one 247 ms sharpening frame at midnight. Steady drawing afterwards holds 60 fps on the phone and 120 fps on the Mac.
options: defer, keeping the evidence so the owner can return to it
outcome: Deferred. The owner said "Skip the Sharpening hitch. It's not important. Record it as such so that I may return to investigate it in the future if I want to." Criterion 2 is struck from this thread; a deferred, low-priority thread carries the evidence and a starting point.
